Bomberman Codes

Every password and secret code for Super Bomberman 1 to 5, Mega Bomberman and the TurboGrafx-16 / PC Engine Bombermans, read from each game's own code and tested in emulators. Make a password or check one. ★ New marks codes that no published list had; Fixed marks ones that were posted wrong.

    Where these come from

    Each game's password routine was disassembled and rebuilt as a small codec. The generator and checker here run those codecs, and the codes were put through each game's own check in an emulator (Mesen 2 for the Super Nintendo and PC Engine games, BizHawk for Mega Bomberman). "Checked in an emulator" on a card means that code was run in the game; "read from the ROM" means it comes from reading the code only.

    Addresses, method and screenshots are in the research notes: .
